main_text.p: Collocatio inventorum argumento-rum. collocationem verò atque tractationem horum argumentorum quod attinet: quatuor epistolarum ἐυχαριστικῶν[?] sunt partes: quarum prima Exordium constat: aut significatione laetitiae & voluptatis examinci beneficio & studio perceptae. lib.13.epi. 24.54.55.l.15.epist.11. Aut gratiarum actio-Exordia gratiarum actionis.ne τῆς εὐχαριστίας[?]. lib.10. epist.11. lib.13. epist. 28.41.42.64. Aut coniunctionis & necessitudinis declaratione.lib.13.epist.62. Aut institutae scriptionis excusatione. libr.13. epist.27. Aut occasionis expositione.libr. Propositiones.3.epist.5. Pars altera Propositio; vel εὐχαριστίαν[?] gratiarum actionem continent.libr. 3.epist.5.l.13.epist.24.62.lib.15.epist.11. vel ἀξίωσιν[?] petitionem habet, ut quod iam fecit amicus; deinceps quoque facere minimè grauetur. lib.10.epist.11. lib.13.epist. Confirmatio-nes.54.62.66. Pars tertia Confirmatio est, quae accepti beneficij commendationem atq; amplificationem complectitur, defump-tam, vel à caufis.lib.3.epist.5. vel effectis. lib.13.epist.28.41.42.64. vel comparatis.l. 10.epist.11.lib.13.epist.27.42. vel adiunctis & circumstantiis:modi.li.10.epist.11.temporis.lib.11.epist.29. personarum.lib.13.e. 27.54.64.lib.15.epist.11.Pars quarta & po-strema Conclusio absoluitur: aut [?] polli-

page.notes: Right-hand edge of the page is cut off; the final word of the last line is cut short, so "polli-" is the printed fragment. The Greek words (ἐυχαριστικῶν, τῆς εὐχαριστίας, εὐχαριστίαν, ἀξίωσιν) and the Greek at the end of the last line are uncertain and marked [?]. The final Greek word after "aut" is not legible enough to transcribe and is left as [?]. The marginal notes "Conclusiones" (at the foot of the left margin) and "Propositiones" were read from the small italic type in the margin; the spacing of the note "Confirmatio-nes" is uncertain. The reading "ftrema" at the start of the last line is "strema" with long s printed as a plain s, from "postrema".
